mentions.name: SwiftUI Admin Dashboard Rewrite
mentions.description: This is a native mobile admin dashboard app, rewritten in SwiftUI with a new, streamlined backend, for a fairly popular free app that has been out for about 2 years. It is faster and simpler than the original UIKit-based dashboard, gives up a couple of features due to SwiftUI's limitations while adding one, and doubles as a test of LLM integration into the developer's workflow.
mentions.problem: The original dashboard app was written in a hurry; while solid and effective, it is clunky.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been developing a rewrite of the dashboard app (admin app) for a fairly popular free app that has been out for just about 2 years.
